function.description: Deploy CALLER-SUPPLIED compiled bytecode as a new contract. For an ordinary token use deploy_token instead — this verb has no template to compare against, so it can only guarantee that the constructor moves no token and grants no allowance, never what the contract does later. Takes COMPILED init code, never Solidity source. dry_run defaults to TRUE.
function.name: defi_trade_deploy_contract

bytecode.description: COMPILED creation bytecode (init code), 0x-prefixed hex. NOT Solidity source — nothing here compiles. To mint an ordinary fixed-supply token, use deploy_token instead: it needs no bytecode and its runtime is asserted against an audited template.

chain.description: Chain to deploy on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas differs by orders of magnitude, so a cent-scale trade can cost more in gas on ethereum than it is worth, while base is a fraction of a cent. Per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

constructor_args.description: ABI-encoded constructor arguments, appended to the bytecode. Leave empty when the constructor takes none.

dry_run.description: TRUE (default) simulates and reports without broadcasting.

max_spend_usd.description: The most USD this deployment may cost — endowment plus worst-case fee.

salt.description: Optional 32-byte hex salt. Set it (or `vanity`) to deploy through the canonical CREATE2 factory, which gives the token the SAME ADDRESS ON EVERY CHAIN for the same bytes. Leave empty for an ordinary nonce-based deploy.

value.description: NATIVE value to endow the constructor with, in whole coin units (not wei). Usually 0.

vanity.description: Optional HEX prefix to mine the address for, e.g. 'b0b' or 'dead' (0-9a-f only, max 8 characters — each character is 16x the work). Implies the CREATE2 path.
